title: MarketplaceTransaction
description: Immutable record of a completed marketplace trade. Source: docs/EDD.md §4.11; docs/SCHEMA.md §2.9 marketplace_transactions. Renamed from legacy TradeRecord (commit ef5c3a9).

listingId.description: FK to marketplace_listings.id (ON DELETE RESTRICT). uq_marketplace_transactions_listing UNIQUE — exactly one completed transaction per listing.

petId.description: Pet traded. Denormalised from listing for fast anti-flip queries.

sellerTokenHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the seller's pet access token at the moment of sale. Raw token never stored.

buyerTokenHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the buyer's pet access token at the moment of purchase.

priceCredits.description: Final agreed sale price in food credits (CHECK price_credits > 0). Denormalised from the listing for financial-audit immutability.

feeCredits.description: Platform fee in food credits: FLOOR(priceCredits * 0.05). MAY be 0 for priceCredits < 20. CONSTANT trade_transaction_fee_percent = 5.

listedAt.description: Copied verbatim from marketplace_listings.listed_at at trade time for audit traceability.

completedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the trade completed and the immutable record was inserted. Doubles as the anti-flip reference point.
